svg.aria-label: Tablet with the plan sheet, phone with the About page and watch with the mark
svg.title: Tablet with the plan sheet, phone with the About page and watch with the mark

text.tspan: Floor planning at Sahra is approached as a balance between
functionality, flow and spatial clarity, where each layout is designed
to support natural movement and everyday living. The organization of
spaces prioritizes openness, proportion and seamless transitions
between areas, ensuring both comfort and efficiency. Every plan is
carefully structured to maximize usability while maintaining a refined
architectural rhythm that enhances the overall living experience.
